_comment: Demo fixture: order the stages of mitosis. The array order below is the correct sequence; the component shuffles for display.
title: Stages of mitosis
prompt: Drag the stages of mitosis into the order they occur, from first to last.

steps.text: Prophase — chromatin condenses into chromosomes; nuclear envelope begins to break down.
Metaphase — chromosomes align along the cell's equatorial plate.
Anaphase — sister chromatids separate and move to opposite poles.
Telophase — nuclear envelopes re-form around the two new sets of chromosomes.
